principle: Live provider-pricing sources (official + secondary) that System 20's crawler (_repos/teleon/backend/src/teleon/economics/provider_intel.py:crawl) fetches and ingests into the economic_observations store, keeping the cost model + router on LIVE economics. Network-gated + registry-driven: honest-unavailable offline or until a source is wired — the crawler never fabricates a price. Wiring a source is an ops action, like adding a credential. serves_truth=false.

source_schema.name: short id for the source (used as the observation source)
source_schema.records_key: (dict responses) the key holding the array of rows; omit for a top-level array
source_schema.resource_field: the row field mapping to our resource_id
source_schema.cost_field: the row field holding per-call cost
